record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.original_question: For every system with two commuting measure-preserving transformations T and S and bounded measurable functions f and g, do the bilinear averages (1/N) Σ_{n=1}^N f(T^n x) g(S^n x) converge for almost every x?

evidence.quote: Problem 19. Let (X, X , µ, T, S) be a system and f, g ∈ L∞(µ) be functions. Show that the averages (1/N) ΣN n=1 f(T^n x) · g(S^n x) converge pointwise almost everywhere.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu)$ be a probability space, and let $T,S:X\to X$ be two commuting measure-preserving transformations (i.e., $TS=ST$, and each preserves $\mu$). For any $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, consider the bilinear ergodic averages
$$A_N(f,g)(x) \;=\; \frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N} f(T^n x)\, g(S^n x).$$
Determine whether, for every such system $(X,\mathcal{X},\mu,T,S)$ and every $f,g\in L^\infty(\mu)$, the sequence $A_N(f,g)(x)$ converges as $N\to\infty$ for $\mu$-almost every $x\in X$.
artifact.status_search_result: Pointwise a.e. convergence of the bilinear averages (1/N)Σ f(T^n x) g(S^n x) for two general commuting measure-preserving transformations T, S is widely cited as an open problem. Recent advances (e.g., Krause–Mirek–Tao 2022) resolved related nonconventional bilinear polynomial averages for a single transformation, and norm-variation results for commuting transformations have appeared, but the a.e. convergence problem for two commuting transformations in the linear case remains open.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise ergodic theorems for non-conventional bilinear polynomial averages
status_evidence.snippet: Resolves pointwise convergence for bilinear polynomial averages with a single transformation T, leaving the two-commuting-transformations case open.
status_evidence.claim: Bilinear pointwise convergence has been settled for polynomial averages along one transformation, but not for two commuting transformations.

status_evidence.title: Norm-variation of triple ergodic averages for commuting transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Studies norm-variation for commuting transformations; pointwise a.e. convergence in the commuting setting beyond Bourgain's two-transformation case remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Pointwise a.e. convergence for averages with commuting transformations is an outstanding open problem.

status_evidence.title: Pointwise ergodic theorems for non-conventional bilinear polynomial averages (Tao's blog)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the status of bilinear pointwise ergodic theorems and notes open cases.
status_evidence.claim: The problem of a.e. convergence of (1/N)Σ f(T^n)g(S^n) for commuting T,S is a recognized open problem.
